title: Rory and the Velvet Moonlit Glade
verses:
The sun dipped down behind the quiet hill,
The evening air was soft and very still.
Then Rory led his sleepy friends along,
While crickets sang a cozy bedtime song.

Now Tilly stopped to watch a glowing light,
That lit the gentle canopy of night.
And Benny gave a soft and sleepy sigh,
Beneath the silver stars up in the sky.

Then Ricky found a soft and cozy nest,
Where all the tired friends could sit and rest.
High up above, Nia began to fold
Her quiet wings against the evening cold.

Psittaco chirped a slow and soothing sound,
And curled up warm upon the mossy ground.
The leaves were swaying gently in the breeze,
And whispered peace among the sleepy trees.

Rory tucked his sleepy friends in tight,
And wished them all a warm and peaceful night.
The river hummed a gentle lullaby,
Beneath the glowing moon so deep and high.

Now every little eye began to close,
As cozy bedtime feelings slowly rose.
Safe in the dark, where gentle shadows creep,
The dinosaur parade fell fast asleep.
